messages:
Maya (CS): Quick ask — just finished onboarding with Northbay. Can we capture 3-4 verbatim voice clips + one prioritized feature ask? Their renewal is Aug and I want to feed product.
Emily R: Yes. I made a 45s capture form: https://rwd.in/quick-clip
Emily R: Suggested fields:
- customer_name
- clip_text (verbatim)
- impact_estimate (low/med/high)
- ask_category (ui/perf/integrations)
Sam P: Add urgency tag + renewal_risk flag. Can we also attach a screenshot? :camera:
Leo - PM: Thx. For prioritization, prefer: impact x frequency -> P0/P1/P2. Add one-line business case.
Maya (CS): Copy. I'll push to the customer now and drop results here.
OnboardBot: Transcript uploaded: https://rwd.in/transcripts/nb-1778 (auto-note)
Emily R: Quick template to paste into form:
```
Customer: Northbay
Clip: "Search latency kills our sales flow at >5s"
Impact: high
Category: perf
Renewal: at-risk
One-liner: Search latency increases checkout dropoff by ~10%.
```
Sam P: I'll create a small table in the product backlog for these field-clips, tag them with 'cs-clip' and link to account health.
Maya (CS): TY! Will share first two clips in 10m. :thumbsup:
Leo - PM: If any ask is integrations >50% impact, ping me directly.
